tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ Add StatusDeferred status, GateReason field, MarkDeferred/ReclaimDeferred methods to Queue interface; cron tick defers entries on high load with gate_reason reason; API exposes gate_reason in queue entry responses; full test coverage: All four sub-requirements verified with code + passing tests. (1) StatusDeferred: internal/ingest/queue.go:33 (`StatusDeferred = "deferred"`). (2) GateReason field: queue.go:152 (`GateReason string `json:"gate_reason,omitempty"``), scanned at queue.go:934, persisted via sql/schema/queue.sql:26 plus an ALTER TABLE migration for existing DBs at queue.go:223. (3) Methods on the Queue interface: internal/cron/loop.go:293-317 declares PeekPending (loop.go:302), MarkDeferred (loop.go:306), ReclaimAllDeferred (loop.go:311); implementations at queue.go:808/827/840/864. (4) Cron tick defers on high load: loop.go:483-491 catches *IdleGateError via errors.As, calls l.deferQueueHead(ctx, gate) and logs gate.deferralLine(); deferQueueHead (loop.go:604-616) peeks the head and calls MarkDeferred(head.ID, gate.Snapshot.Reason) where Reason is "load"/"memory"/"load+memory"; the idle path reclaims via ReclaimAllDeferred (loop.go:497-501). (5) API exposure: handlers.go:166 wire field, handlers.go:838 entryToWire sets GateReason, handlers.go:885 deferred branch keeps position but empties estimated_time; pkg/api/openapi.yaml:735 documents gate_reason; docs/api-reference.md:403 documents semantics. (6) Test coverage — actual command output: `go test ./internal/cron/ ./internal/api/ -run 'Defer|Gate' -count=1 -v` => `--- PASS: TestTickGateDeferralStampsQueueHead`, `--- PASS: TestTickGateDeferralMemoryLine`, `--- PASS: TestRunGateDeferralIsNotATickError`, `--- PASS: TestTickGateOpenReclaimsAndSolves`, `--- PASS: TestTickGateDeferral_RealQueuePersistence`, `--- PASS: TestGetQueueStatus_DeferredEntryShape`, `ok internal/cron 0.008s`, `ok internal/api 0.008s`. Tests are non-vacuous: loop_test.go:1021 drives the REAL ingest.Queue asserting status=deferred/stage=gated/gate_reason=memory then reclaim-to-complete with gate_reason cleared; handlers_test.go:3505 asserts the raw JSON contains the gate_reason key and empty estimated_time. Full gate: `go build ./...` exit 0, `go vet ./...` exit 0, `gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/` empty, `go test ./... -short -count=1 -p 1 -timeout 300s` => all 16 packages `ok` (cron, ingest, api, pkg/api, cmd/off-by-one, export, graph, import, metrics, muster, sandbox, seed, solver, tools, web).
Host-pressure gate fully implemented end-to-end — StatusDeferred/GateReason/MarkDeferred/ReclaimDeferred on the Queue interface, cron tick deferring the queue head with the gate reason, gate_reason exposed in API responses and OpenAPI, with real-queue E2E and API tests all passing alongside a clean build/vet/gofmt and full test suite.
